name: ForceDimension
description: Force Dimension is a robotics company founded in 2001 in Nyon, Switzerland, as a spin-off from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne (EPFL). The company designs and manufactures parallel-kinematic delta haptic master interfaces, including the [omega.x](/robot/force_dimension_omega), [sigma.7](/robot/force_dimension_sigma), and [lambda.7](/robot/force_dimension_lambda) series used in surgical robotics research and teleoperation consoles.
